title: Can you judge these two small pieces of film writing?

commenti.body:
Are you the same redditor that kept spamming log lines to all the film related subs? I'm guessing probably yes since you have a brand new account and have already posted this to 2 different subs.

As a former wanna-be writer, I'll give you one piece of advice--getting feedback from random people is absolutely useless, and doing it the way you're doing it is just annoying. Join a writing group or three, build relationships with those people, and follow the process.
Can the mod team IP ban this guy? It's seriously grating
